notes.title: Regular Game Update 9
notes.notes:
Hi there Sky pilots,

It's been a while. I'm just busy with the game, since we are nearing a potential release. 

This update brings the training mode, where you can learn about the game's mechanics and how to get scores. 

The Tate mode (Horizontal screen) has an interactive tutorial, where you can test stuff out.
Sadly and due to technical issues, the Yoko mode (vertical screen) only has a picture tutorial.

I hope you like it.

Other than that, a few bugs were fixed.

I guess that's all for this regular patch. See you around!

Shinu.

notes.title: MAJOR GAME UPDATE 7
notes.notes:
Hi there pilots,

Recently, I've got a huge feedback from the community and been busy working on that. Alongside the regular bug fixes, I've got the following changes done, hoping they improve the over all quality of the core gameplay:

- 	Players do not lose all their power ups after a hit, they only get down by 1 level, but lose all turrets.
-	Continue now reduces score to 0.
-	Enemies bullets colors changed to match backgrounds and player fire.
-	Slowing down some enemy bullets on stage 01.
-	Turbo B no longer can shoot and charge at the same time. Which was a bug that removed the risk 
         purpose of his play style.
-	Cool down for Turbo B special is now faster.
-	Turbo B gets invincibility after creating a Shockwave, just like Amira
-	The horizontal horizontal scrolling of the backgrounds is improved for better bullets tracking.

Thanks again for the feedback and support! I hope these changes improve the game.
Right now work on stage 5 is going smoothly.

Cheers,

Shinu

notes.title: REGULAR GAME UPDATE - WE CAN REDO!
notes.notes:
Hi there pilots!
Version 1.2.2 is here and, alongside many bug fixes, it brings a new feature: Restart.
Listening to feedback, the restart feature is mostly for 1cc players, because it restarts the game to stage 1 and deletes all progress like score, power ups and collected crystals. 

For people who want a stage restart option in order to practice, rest assured, the game will have a practice mode and even a boss rush mode.

Thanks a lot for the continuous support and feedback! now, work on stage 5 is starting.

Shinu

notes.title: MAJOR GAME UPDATE 6
notes.notes:
Hello pilots,

As the title mentions, the new patch 1.1.1 brings some changes to the core system.

I've been getting a lot of feedback on the item/power ups drop system. The old system was part randomized and part checking the player's state in order to drop the necessary items. However, players didn't like this method, so I want with the traditional take and created item carriers that disposes power ups, add-ons, bombs etc. at certain parts of the stage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44988312/1a043bb0109bf90cdef8d6edbf2739c161db331d.gif

I also added a bonus drop at the end of each stage to help players start the next stage with some fire power in case they've lost them during the boss fight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44988312/1ca88e9af800db722d92eefadaf66421fb5760ce.png

Also, I did some optimization for both players so none overpowers the other.


Other than that, so minor bugs are fixed, namely the new achievements for boss 02.


With that, I4ll be taking my leave and resume working on stage 3.

Cheers,

Here comes one of the most wanted features in any game. I finally managed to include gamepads and keyboard key mapping for the arcade mode. It will be available for player 2 once two players mode is ready.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35235732/e754fee99d64ee1a33251f295fdce76cea02cb94.jpg


Now the game can support Playstation gamepads like the Dualshock 4 and 5. You can also choose which gamepad you want to use, port 1 or 2, even if they are both connected, no need to unplug the unwanted one. This comes in handy once the two players mode is available.

Alongside this main update, I also fixed various bugs reported by you guys, which I really appreciate.

I'll be counting on your support. Please wishlist the game and share any bugs encountered or feedback. It helps a ton.

Cheers!

notes.title: GAME UPDATE 02 (MAJOR)
notes.notes:
Hi there pilots!

A big patch was finally added to the demo. It took a while because it brings some cool content. Here's what's new:

- A new character for the arcade mode:
This new player, called "Turbo B." (let's see who'll get the reference) is totally different from Amira. In contrast to her, he doesn't have a power up super attack, but rather a charging and waiting mechanism. Which means that he's more on the technical side.

- New artworks for the side panels.
- Improved gameplay.
- New cutscenes and dialogs for the new player.
- Improved audio sfx for Amira.
- Many bug fixes.

Major plans for the next patch:
- Two players mode:
I'll be making the two players coop mode available, since we now have a 2nd player. But this mode requires a lot of work.
- Button mapping options:
Since we'll have the two players mode, a button mapping option is mandatory. I'll be working on adding button mapping for the keyboard, Xbox and PS gamepads.

I hope you guys are enjoying the demo. Please support this game with wishlisting, feedback and bug reports. The community is all what we have as a solo indie dev for shmups.

Cheers,

Shinu.

notes.title: Demo Update ver 1.0.1 (First update, yeay!!)
notes.notes:
Hi there pilots!

Thanks a lot for trying out the demo and providing me with feedback and bug reports!

Thanks to that, I've been able to work on the first patch for Shockwave Triggers. Here's what I've worked on:

- Improved visuals for the player's art.
- Added Tate mode 2 for counterclockwise rotation. (Even made some cool rotation effects).
- Fixed the keyboard controls for Tate normal and reversed (yes, you can play Tate mode on a normal horizontal screen, just go to pause options and reverse the controls).
- Improved the gameplay for the scoring system.
- Added "dark bgd" and "desaturated bgd" modes for people who have issues with visibility.

Alright, there's more work waiting for the next update, upcoming are:

- A 2nd character.
- 2 player couch coop.
And more, who knows :) 

Alright pilots, gotta take my leave for now. Please don't forget to support me with wishlisting, feedback and commenting, also, sharing is caring :)

Shinu
